tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ḍākki dril sgrub gsang ba snying gi dum bu

bzhugs pa lags so: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s rigs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor pa 'khor ba blos btang pa: ri khrod dgon pa 'grim nus pa zha ི ga gis: yang gsang ḍākki snying thig bsgom zhing : ḍākki lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par 'dod pas: ḍākki thod rgal gnad 'bebs su bsgrub par bya ste: de la gsum rnal 'byor bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ngo : de la dang po lha'i rnal 'byor dang gcig: sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang gnyis: rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor dang gsum: las mtha'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o: rgya rgya rgya: de la dang po lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyis las la sbyar ro: de yang rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags kyis sku gsal gdab pa ni: ngag tu: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥpadma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: zhes brjod pas: bdag rdo rje phag mor bsgom ste: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma khrau zhal spyan gsum la sogs pa gzhung dang mthun: de ltar gtso mo bskyed nas de la bskor ba'i 'khor bskyed pa ni: shar du rdo rje ḍākki dkar: lhor rin chen ḍākki ser: nub tu padma ḍākki dmar: byang du las kyi ḍākki ljang : bzhi po des bskor ba g.yas bskor du sgo ro ro bskor bar bsams la: sngags yig 'bru bcu po 'di drag tu bzlas so: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya gtso mo chos nyid kyi ngang du 'gyur med du bsgom mo 'khor rnams glu dang gar dang skor ba dang 'khrab pa dang dgod pa dang ldeg pa dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su bsgom mo : zhes drag tu zhag bdun bzlas so: de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis: rtags ni 'du ba rnam gsum 'byung : khrom 'du mi 'du bud med 'du: nor dang ḍākki chos skyong 'du: sngags btsun skye bo rgyal 'bangs 'du: 'bar ba gsum 'byung ste: bdag gi shes pa 'gyur ba dang :

'phar ba dang : ldeg pa dang : 'khrab pa dang : sems bde bar shar nas 'khrab snying 'dod pa rnams 'byung ngo : de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi thun 'jog tsa na 'khor 'phro bcad pas nyams bde lam 'gro'o: de nas gtor ma gtang ba ni dbus su che ba gcig la mtha' ma 'dab ma bzhis bskor ba la sha lnga: bdud rtsi lnga: mar: nas: khur ba: chang : sgog pa la sogs pa ci 'byor bran no: stong gsum gang bar sprul nas dbul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma gu ru khā hi khā hi: buddha ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: badzra ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: ratna ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: padma ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: karma ḍākki ni khā hi khā nyi: bhi shwa ḍākki ni khā hi bha hi: lo ka ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: las mkhan ḍākki ni i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes 'bul lo: de nas gyer sgom du bya ba'i phyir dbyangs dang bcas pas thod rnga dkrol zhing 'di skad du: hūm̐ ma skyes rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid nas: zhes pa sogs kyis bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo: bskul bya zhing nyams skyong ngo : yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ngo : de ltar bsgrubs na rab zhag bdun: 'bring nyer gcig tha mas kyang zla ba gcig gis 'grub nges so: rgya rgya rgya: athi+-i: o rgyan padma bdag nyid la: 'di las zab pa'i chos med pas: 'di dang snying thig sbrel ba na: rin chen gser gyi maṇḍal la: g.yu yi rgyan gyis bkod dang 'dra: bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa ste: 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung : ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis: lan cig dus kyi tha ma la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gcig las spel na snying khrag thang la phos shig gter srung rnams: rgya rgya rgya: ༄༅/ /lo rgyus bzhugs so: o rgyan padma bdag nyid la: padma 'od kyi gur khang du: sangs rgyas rigs kyi ḍākki mas: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad: bstan nas 'di nyid ma bstan par:

sgom sgrub mdzod cig sprul pa'i sku: zer nas med par song ba dang : o rgyan padma bdag gis su: bod yul dbus su khyer nas byon: de nas gtsang g.ya' ri gong du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su nub gcig ḍākki ma dngos su byon nas: o rgyan khyod kyis nga'i chos zab zong du ma btang zhig: zer nas mi snang bar song ba ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas bltas pas thugs srog 'di zhu ba brjed 'dug pa mthong nas: bdud rtsi a mṛ ta khal gcig phyag rten du phul nas gsol ba btab ste 'di zhus pas: 'khor gyi ḍākki rnams ma mnyes par spyan chab bku'o: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ rdzas bzhugs so: o rgyan la na mo: ḍākki thod rgal du bsgrub pa las: sbas dang gab med gyib med pa'i: gnad sgrub man ngag dam pa 'di: sangs rgyas ḍākki nyid kyis su: bka' rgya mna' dang bcas nas byin: gnad sgrub 'phrul gyi dum bu las: mkha' 'gro'i rdzas gnad 'di las med: bud med bzhi bcu man chad nas: bcu gnyis yan chad grir shi'i snying : de yang mtshan ldan mchog tu bshad: bye ba dang yugs sa mo nad bu gcong can mdze byung ba mi rung ngo : skyes pa dag kyang de dang 'dra: skyes dar gri ru shi ba'i snying : pho mo ma 'phrad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis te bzhi'o: sin dhu ra dang gcig: ghi waṃ dang gnyis: a mṛ ta en cig dang gsum: mthing gi shog gu la gser dang mtshal bsres pas srog snying bris pa dang bzhi: me long mtho skor ma dang gcig: thod pa ltag sprod dang gnyis: dril bu dang gsum: thod pa dum bu gcig pa dang bzhi: rdo rje phag mo'i sku tsa ka li dang lnga'o: de rnams bsag go: gnad sgrub 'phrul gyi dum bu las: bsgrub mi dgos te bsags pas 'grub: rgya rgya rgya: 'di rdzas bsags pas 'grub pa yin: sog pa dang 'grub pa dus mnyam du 'byung : mdzod kyi mthil yin rdzas kyi sgrub pa 'di: bsam pas 'grub pas khyad par 'phags so:

athi+-i: ḍākki sgrub pa thod rgal sgrub pa la: sgrub pa'i bca' thabs bstan par bya: 'di ni ḍākki'i srog snying 'chang bar bcang ba'o gnad yig yin: gzhan la spel na srog la yong : gnad kyi yi ge 'di ltar bca': dang po rnal 'byor gding dang ldan pas bdag nyid kyis: dben pa'i gnas sam mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i sa dur khrod du: rdzas dang yo byad kun khyer nas: maṇḍal zla gam dbang dang 'dra dmar po byug: phyogs kyi zhi rgyas kha dog gzhan dang mthun: de steng mañdzi'i steng du ni: thod pa dum bu gcig pa bzhag: de yi nang du srog snying yi ge gnad: 'khor lo rdzas dang tsitta dang bcas pa bzhugs: bskyed rim 'khor lo bskor ba gzhung ltar shes: srog snying gnad nas sgrub dus thun bzhi bcag na smyo 'bogs 'ong gzir ba drag por bshad: gong ma' ི hrī ma la sogs yi ge bcu pa la: rtsa drug pa 'di btags zhag bdun bzlas pas 'grub: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ri ni sa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ra tsa hrī ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sarba siddhi hring hring hring : dza dza dza: zhes bzlas so: de ltar gsang sngags so drug pa: zhag bdun bzlas pas rtags rnams rdzogs: 'di la bsnyen pa ma them par: las tshogs spyad kyang rang la ldog pas don med de: nus med 'dre rdung byed dang 'dra: them nas las tshogs spyod pas gsum pa dang brgya rtsa la chog: thun bzhi bcag na dam tshig nyams: mkha' 'gro gnad kyi sgrub thabs srog sgrub 'di yin no: 'di min gter du sbas pa med: rgya rgya rgya: gnad 'bebs bla rdo: ༄༅ / / o rgyan bdag gi thugs phyung ba: gnad 'bebs srog snying bcang thabs ni: dang po gtso mo'i sku bris la: de yi lto bar 'khor la ོ sindhu byang sems dkar dmar mtshal ghi waṃ tsandan dkar dmar gnyis bud med mtshan ldan ma rus pa mi gcig pa bzhi'i gdong gi dreg pa de tsho 'khor lo bri ba'i rdzas so bskor: rtsibs bzhi rtse mo nang du bstan:

de la mo yig bzhi po mgo nang du bstan la bri: srog snying gnad kyi yi ge so drug lte bar bri: rtsibs mchan lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus shig bri: mu khyud rten 'brel bri bar bya: zur gsum dag la gser las bris pa'i snying po dag: gtso mo'i snying khar mgo thur du bstan rgyab nas dgab: mgo mjug ma log dril byas la: dar zab sna lnga dag gis gril: zangs kyi ga 'u'i nang du gzhug: de ni zhing chen lpags kyis gtums: de ni dar zab dag gis gril: g.yas pa'i mchan 'og dag tu bcang : mkha' 'gro lus dang grib ma 'dra: gzhan la spel na rang srog 'chad: ma spel snying gi dkyil du chongs: dril sgrub snying gi dum bu 'di: 'di min gter du sbas pa med: rgya rgya rgya: las tshogs gsum gyi dang po: o rgyan nyid la na mo: gnad sgrub 'phrul gya ི man ngag gi bcud yin dum bu las: re ma ti thugs kyi sgrub pa yin: o rgyan padma bdag gis su: ma ning mtsho yi 'gram du ni: zhag bdun gcod kyi dmigs pa bskor: bud med dmar nag gcig gis ni: nad kyi rkyal pa thogs nas su: o rgyan bdag la 'thor du byung : o rgyan bdag gis sa ma ti yis zil gyis mnan: skad cig mi sdug gzugs zhi nas: na chung lha'i bu mo mdzes ma stong du sprul: o rgyan bdag la srog snying phul: e ma ma tri dza: ma ma rag mo raṃ ma ga ma dza: rag mo sing ha dza: rag mo ru ru dza: ma ma duṃ duṃ dza: ma mo ma mo: sa ma ya trig trig rbad rbad dza: zhes phul nas: o rgyan gyi bka' ci bsgo nyan par dam bcas so: de nas o rgyan gyis zhus pa: khyod kyi ming dang : rigs dang : drag rtsal rnams shod cig: ces brjod pas khong na re: nged las kyi rigs kyi gnod drag rtsal can sbyin mo yin: ming gnod sbyin mo nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes kyang zer: ma mo nyi ma rlung gi gshog pa can yang zer: las mkhan dbang mo che zhes kyang zer ro: drag rtsal ni skad cig ma la gling bzhi bskor nus:

skad cig la srid gsum dbang du sdud nus pa yin zer ro: de nas o rgyan gyis bdud rtsi mchod nas zhus pa: snyigs ma'i dus su rang ma smin par gzhan la dbang bskur: 'gro ba ma thul par dad gus ma skyes pa'i chos zab lto ru nor 'dod byed cing 'tshong ba'i dus su 'byung : de dus o rgyan nga'i chos zab 'debs pa la: mos gus kyi sngon du dgos pas: 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i thabs shig ston cig gsungs pa dang : khong na re nged kyis bstan kyang dam tshig thub par dka': bod kyi mi la snying rus med zer ro: dam tshig dka' ba ci dang ci bsrung dgos zhus pas: khong na re: nged gnod sbyin mo yin pas dam tshig ma thub na log lta che bas srog la 'ong : dam tshig thub na rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i sku bas che'o: nged la sgrub pa byas nas su: rgyun gyi gtor ma ma chag dgos: mdze yugs shan pa mi thong dang : bye ba la sogs grib can rnams la 'dzem gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i dus su de rnams la ma 'dzem na dam nyam pas mi 'grub bo : de ltar dam tshig thub bam gsung : o rgyan bdag gis thugs dgongs nas: sgrub thabs ston cig dam tshig bsrung ngo zhus pas: de nas bstan pa phag mo khong rang gis: yang gsang gter gyi sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum dril nas gsungs so: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bca' thabs 'di ltar bya: ro ras zhing chen dag la ni: ri bong khrag ra khrag khyi dmar po'i khrag rta khrag tsan dan dmar po'i chu nya mkhris de rnams 'khor lo bri ba'i rdzas yin no 'khor lo rtsibs ni bcu drug bri: lte bar gnod sbyin mo nag mo: zhal gcig phyag bzhi yod pa phyag g.yas na 'phrul gyi zhags pa bsnam pa: 'og ma na dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bsnams pa: g.yon na gsal byed kyi me long bsnams pa: 'og ma na lcags kyu bsnams pa bri: de'i tha ma gong ma'i srog sngags kyis bskor: rtsibs bcu drug gi rtse mo nang du bstan:

de la bri ba'i sngags 'di'o: yig mgo nang du bstan la: ma ma rag mo rag mo: sing da sing da : rag mo thuṃ rag mo thuṃ: rag mo rgyugs rag mo rgyugs: ru lu rgyugs ru lu rgyugs: e ru lu rgyugs: e ru lu rgyugs: dza tri dza dza tri dza dza: zhes rtsibs la bri'o: drag sngags mtha' dag gis bskor: de'i tha ma rang gi yi dam sngags kyis bskor: dgug gnod sbyin mo 'dren byas nas mdzo mo nag mo'i rwa nang gzhug mgo mjug zlog la kha bal nag gis bcad la rang gi gdan 'og gru gsum nang du mgo gzhug bzlog gzhug: de'i steng du seng ldeng phur pa sor bcu gnyis pa gzug go: de'i steng du g.yam pa la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas dgab: de'i steng du rang nyal bar bskyed rim gsal bas bya'o: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gcig tu dril ba'i sngags yang gsang bla na med pa e ma ma tri dza: ma ma rag mo rag mo dza: rag mo sing nga dza: rag mo ru ru dza: rag mo duṃ duṃ dza: ma mo ma mo: sa ma ya: trig trig rbad rbad dza: bag rnir khug bag rnir khug: ma dung ma dung rnir khug: rnir dkrugs rnir dkrugs: rnir chog rnir chog: gnod sbyin nag mos dbang du sdus dbang du sdus: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus shig: dza dza: hring hring longs spyod thams cad dbang du sdus shig: ces bzlas pa sngags 'di bzlas pa'i dus su ni : brtul zhugs dag dang mi ldan na: rang srog chad de nyes pa che: de tshe shin tu gtsang bar bya'o: drag tu bya'o: rtags ni rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni mngon sum dag tu 'byung : 'bring ni rmi lam dag tu 'byung : tha ma'ang phyad phyod du shes pa 'gyur tsam 'byung : de la rtags rnams ma byung na: sngags dkrugs rtsa gsum zhal phye la: zhag bdun thun thun sngags gzhan nas gyis dus bzhir brab: de yis rtags rnams nub re la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon gsum ston: de las zhag bdun las mang na rang srog 'chad:

de nas tsakra sman chus bkru: de nas gnod sbyin bud med phyag mtshan gong dang 'dra'o kyi gzugs bse'i skra bshal nas rgyug pa'i gzugs bris la: snying khar srog sngags bris la mdun du bzhag: drag po nyung kar la dug khrag sbol la thun gyis mo'i rgyab nas gzir: dam tshig gnad kyi bskul tshig bdun pa 'dis bskul lo: kyai gnod sbyin nag mo bse yi ral pa can: mu men mtsho yi 'gram shed du: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la: mdongs gsol srog gi snying po phul: khas blangs dam bcas da rgyugs shig: gnod sbyin chen mo da rgyugs shig: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus la shog: ces drag tu bskul rgyun gtor sbyin la drag tu dus bzhir lo: de ltar bsgrubs na ma dang bu mo pha la sogs pa mos lugs rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams sha la sbrang bzhin khyad par bud med 'du'o: rgya rgya rgya: dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo 'di: mkhas pa'i tshig la ma brten par: gnod sbyin nyid kyis dngos su bstan: 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa la: 'di nyid yod na mi 'dus med: des na 'di nyid zab par bshad: rgya rgya rgya:

EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s las tshogs gnyis pa: de ltar sgrub pa thon nas ni: rgyal khams dbang du sdud 'dod na: rten 'brel 'di ltar shes par bya: rigs mi gcig pa'i mtshan brtags pa gal che bud med ni: rgyal rigs rje'u dar ma rigs kyi bu mo rigs bram ze'i rigs: dmangs rigs gdol ba'i rigs dang lnga: brgya dang bcu gnyis man chad bar: skyes pas ma spyad chu shul zhag du ma lon pa sa blangs la: byang sems dkar dmar gnyis dang bsre: g.yang kha'i sa dang sba yi rtsi: mi mang 'dus pa'i sa dang lnga: rtsi bzhin snur la thod pa ni: dum bu gcig pa'i nang du blug: de ni maṇḍal dbus su bzhag: sngags 'di zhag bdun bar du bsgrub: e ma dung dung : ding ding : hring hring : sha sho sha sho: g.yer ya g.yer ya: dza na dza na: rnir dza rnir dza: shul chu ma shul chu ma: g.yos: g.yos: khams gsum g.yos: dkrugs dkrugs srid gsum dkrugs: sdus sdus srid gsum dbang du sdus: g.yos khams gsum g.yo ru chug: dung rnir dza dung rnir dza: e dung e dung swāhā: zhes dus bzhir sngags chus rdzas la kha phru gdab: de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis: rtags ni rang nyid rlung gis khyer ba rmi: dngos su mig rtsa 'gul du 'ong : lus kyi sha yang 'gul du 'ong : de ltar rtags rnams byung nas ni: rdzas phyed snyug rgod nang du ni: blugs la rang gi spyi bor bcang : rdzas phyed lung gsum mdo na nyi ma dmar thag chad pa'i dus su rlung la phyar: des ni rgyal khams pha ma bzhin du dbang du 'dus: thams cad dbang du sdud pa la: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi: tsitta rin chen kha phye yang : 'di las zab pa yod re kan: ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis: rgya rgya rgya: ༄༅: las tshogs gsum pa: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s : o rgyan nyid la na mo: dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pas: 'gro ba dbang du 'dus nas ni: gsang sngags bde ba sbyor 'dod na: ḍākki mtshan ldan brtags nas ni:

rnal 'byor thabs dang ldan pa yis: gsang spyod ri khrod 'gugs 'dod na: rten 'brel gnad ni gsum du bshad: bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo ni: sku mdog ljang gu dag tu bsgom: phyag mtshan cha lugs gong dang 'dra: spro dmigs yul gang yin bsdu dgug gzhug drag tu bya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzas kyi gnad ni 'di ru 'dus: gang 'gugs chu shul sa dang gcig: byang sems dkar dmar gnyis te gsum: sbrang rgod chang gi nur rtsi lnga: khyim bya'i rdo rje mtshan dang rdo rje mi mtshan dang : de rnams rtsi bzhin btags nas ni: ba ru gson po la bud pa'i nang du blug: gong gi maṇḍal mkha' 'gro'i zla gam steng bzhag bsgrub: che ge 'dra ba'i ling ga rgyan dang ldan pa gcig: byang sems snag tsha dang bsres la dkar dmar gnyis kyis bri: de yang ba ru'i nang du kha spra tshil bcad gzhug: dkar dmar bal tshon skud pas gzungs thag bya: gzungs thag rang gi mtshan ma rdo rje'i rked pa la: btags la sngags 'dis zhag gsum bsgrub: karma ḍākki ni karma dpa' bo hūṃ hūṃ dza dza: ha ri ni sa che ge chum chum: dung dung breng breng : 'dur 'dur khol g.ya' khol: bram shig bram shig: klaung shog slog shugs: ma ri khur ma ri khur: nyong nyong ha ḍa ni khug: chgai khug shog khug shog: rnam par shes pa chos bzhin bdag gi dbang du sdus shig: ces bzlas so: rgya rgya rgya: rtags ni 'di ltar shes par bya: gsang ba'i rdo rje za 'gul 'byung : rmi lam bud med tshogs 'dus nas: bdag la mna' ni bsgag tu 'ong : de ltar byung na 'grub pa yin: rab khong du gtong dang 'bring lus la byug dang gdab tha ma spyi bor gsum bya: 'di ni shin tu zab pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs mang bzhugs kyang : srog snying gnad kyi dril sgrub 'di: 'di min gter du sbas pa med: bskal ba snyigs ma byung ba'i tshe: las can gcig gis rnyed par shog:

ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis: gcig las spel na snying khrag thang la phos shig: gter srung rnams: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: athi+-i: mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgya ma rig ma'i brtag pa lam 'bras na yod 'gugs pa gong ga ི 'di: rgyal ba dang lung bzhin o rgyan gyis spyad pas dngos grub mchog dang thun mong thob 'phral du tshe 'di la : phal pa 'di med rnams la ci cha yod: ḍākki lam 'bras nas bshad pa bzhin du nyams su long la ni gzhung du tshul bzhin gyis shig: maṅgalaṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)ḍākki dril sgrub gsang ba snying gi dum bu/ - PAGE 102 -- PAGE 111 -- PAGE 101 -
